utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I'll be there Saturday morning to help sort and set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Saturday? I think I can manage that... as long as I remember where I parked my car that morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: My memory's not much better these days either, Oren. We'll both manage somehow.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center—got my toolbox all packed and ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's good to hear, Gus. I just swung by the hardware store for some extra supplies—glad to see folks are getting ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Ira! We'll have everything we need to tackle those broken appliances.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, so it's a community repair event, not a USB drive? That's even better—I'd love to help fix things together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday! I'm bringing my broken toaster and helping out. Glad you're interested!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds great! I'll bring my old blender that's been acting up. Count me in for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Jules said they're in too—but I'm still not sure what exactly we're fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Don't worry, Noah! Just bring whatever's broken and we'll figure it out together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Alright, I'll grab my old toaster—though I'm still not sure if we're fixing it or just moving it to a different shelf.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Nell—are you talking about the same one the Hendersons are running?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the Hendersons? I didn't know they were involved—I just heard it's happening from Opal and Eli.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you weren't aware? Vik and Dane both mentioned the Hendersons specifically—are you sure it's the same event?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey, did you hear? Gus is donating his old tools—this weekend's repair drive is really coming together!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, that's good news. I hope they've got a proper timeline set up—I like to know when things are happening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Eli! I'm working on the schedule now—planning to have everything laid out by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Quinn mentioned you're helping with the repair drive too. I might have some old tools to bring—still deciding.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that would be brilliant! Every little bit helps—we can always use more tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'll dig through my garage tonight and see what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center at 10 a.m. — come drop off your rusty tools!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I'll see you Saturday with that old wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll make sure there's a spot for your wrenches. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that's the one. I've been helping them get it ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to have you on board, Dane! We could use more hands—want to bring anyone else along?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'll ask around—maybe my buddy Leo can lend a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Leo, have you checked if we've got all the spare parts for the repair drive? I'd hate to find out we're missing something critical.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got a hammer, but if we’re short on parts, we might need to grab some before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday? Oh, that's cutting it close. Have we actually confirmed that everyone's available that day?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, I'm so glad you're here—have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? Jules is leading it, and I'm helping spread the word around Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mara, tell me straight—do you think this repair drive will actually fix our street, or is it just window dressing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, it's real—I saw Jules fix a toaster that was older than me last week! And I'm bringing my own tools, so we'll definitely get some real mending done.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing up old appliances at the community center—it's going to be quite the event!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I think there's been a mix-up, Tess! The repair drive is actually on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: What? Sunday? Are you sure, Rosa? I could've sworn Opal told me it was Saturday... well, I'll double-check with her, but thanks for the heads-up!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I noticed you heading over to the repair drive earlier. Did you find the spot okay?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I found it alright. Just trying to keep busy with something useful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Glad to hear you made it. The community center is a bit tucked away, but it's a good spot for these events.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Oren, it sounds like we're all set for Saturday at the community center—I think Ira's even picking up some tools for me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Saturday! I'll try to remember to bring that old lamp of mine.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I hope you can make it, Oren—I bet Ira could even give you a hand with that lamp if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got my truck loaded with wrenches and a sander—ready to roll over to the community center Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, wait—didn't Opal say it's Saturday? Sunday might be the wrong day, man.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No, Bo, it got moved to Sunday at the community center—Opal must have an old flyer.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, a repair drive? I thought we were just talking about fixing a car or something. What exactly are we repairing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's a community event where we fix all sorts of things—toasters, chairs, bikes, you name it—to keep stuff out of the landfill. And it's been moved to Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sunday? Wait, I thought it was Saturday. Did I miss a change in plans again?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well Tess, I'm hoping it's the real deal—Pia mentioned a proper schedule with specific tasks. I just wish she'd share it with us sooner.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you know Pia—she likes to keep us on our toes! But I heard from Cleo that they're setting up a workshop space, so we'll have plenty to do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A workshop space, huh? That sounds promising. I just hope they've got a timeline posted somewhere—I'm too old for last-minute surprises.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I'm running to the hardware store now. Need me to pick up any extra tools for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is this the same repair drive the Hendersons are running? I just want to make sure I've got the right details before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, yeah, that's the one! The Hendersons are spearheading it—I can grab whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, yeah the repair drive's shaping up nicely—just need to finalize a couple of tool kits and we're set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—I’ll bring a hammer like Jules asked. Anything else you need from my end?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nah, just show up with that hammer and a good attitude. I've got the rest covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got some extra parts sorted—just need a steady table to set up on. Saturday's looking good for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got a sturdy folding table I can bring over, Cleo. Happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's wonderful, Sam! That table will be perfect—just like the setup we had last time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mina, have we checked the inventory for the repair drive? I want to make sure we have all the essentials before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven't checked yet, but I figure we should start with the basics—do you have a list of what we're bringing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I've got a list right here—screwdrivers, wrenches, spare cables, and a multimeter. Let's make sure we're not forgetting anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Faye, I was wondering if you'd heard about that repair drive coming up? Quinn mentioned it to me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes, I've been helping coordinate it! We're planning to set up a repair station this weekend—Gus is donating some old power tools that just need a little TLC.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great to hear about Gus's tools. What time do you need people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Mara—there's been a change. The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. Can you still make it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Ah, thanks for the heads up, Rosa—Sunday works for me too. I'll be there at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara! I've got you down for Sunday at 9 AM—see you there!
